title: Field protocol v1 protected credential channel
description: The only place credential material may cross the process boundary. This channel is not standard input, output, or error; it is the descriptor named in the collection request's credential grant. Its frames are newline-delimited JSON with the same limits as the main stream. Credential material appears nowhere else: not in process arguments, not in the inherited environment, not in event streams, not in logs, not in cursors, and not in notebook material. Neither a request nor a response frame may be written to any log, diagnostic, or file.

credentialRequest.title: credential_request (Field to core, on the protected channel)

purpose.description: What the Field needs. 'access_token' is the normal case; 'renew' asks core to obtain fresh material when core owns refresh.

credentialResponse.title: credential_response (core to Field, on the protected channel)

material.description: Present only when the outcome is 'granted'. This is the sole member of the entire protocol that carries a secret, and it exists only on this channel. The Field must hold it in memory for the minimum useful time and must never copy it into a record, checkpoint, diagnostic, cursor, log line, or file.

message.description: Present when the outcome is not 'granted'. Actionable and secret-free.
